entries.rationale: Ae.solator keeps its own canonical packaged component catalog and shipped runtime asset layout. Donor payload/version churn under installable or installed component lanes is not accepted blindly over the current product-owned package surface.
Decompiled apktool output is evidence-only and never canonical source-of-truth for Ae.solator. It must not compete with the live app tree during donor arbitration.

The virglrenderer subtree was conflict-aware synced from the dominant Winlator donor line and then normalized locally to remove donor formatting residue such as trailing whitespace. The remaining byte drift is formatting hygiene, not unresolved product logic.

The cmod/xserver subtree was refreshed from the dominant donor family and normalized locally for LF/whitespace hygiene. Remaining drift against minority donor variants is donor-family split, not missing Ae.solator runtime/XServer logic.

Ae.solator owns a migrated Java package layout under com.winlator.cmod.* for these runtime and XServer surfaces. Donor-only paths that still target the legacy com.winlator.* package root are not missing functionality here when a canonical cmod twin already exists in the local tree.

Ae.solator intentionally keeps a stronger Android app contract on this surface than the dominant donor majority: cmod package ownership, themed UI resources, manifest/runtime permissions, FreeWine start-menu payload, and native build wiring for virgl/vortek/gladio/OpenXR/adrenotools lanes. The dominant donor blobs on these paths are older generic Winlator app surfaces and would regress current product-owned runtime and UX behavior.

Donor-only com.winlator.* root package lanes on these prefixes are legacy Winlator app surfaces. Current Ae.solator source-of-truth lives in cmod-owned packages or other explicitly integrated owner families; these donor-only root-package additions are not wired into the live app graph.
These donor-only layout/menu resources are not referenced by the current Ae.solator source tree and represent legacy or sidecar UI lanes, not missing live app wiring on the current product line.

The live com.winlator.cmod.* tree is Ae.solator source-of-truth for current runtime, container, UI-state, translator, and launch routing logic. Donor drift on already-existing cmod paths is adjudicated in favor of the current product-owned implementation unless a narrower merge wave overrides it.

These current native/build/runtime asset surfaces are already owned and wired by the live Ae.solator product line. Donor-majority blobs here are generic or older app variants and do not supersede the current product contract.

These donor-only packaged archives, versioned runtime payloads, bundled sidecar libraries, and auxiliary build fragments are product proposals rather than current Ae.solator source-of-truth. They cannot displace the current content/version/package contract without an explicit integration wave.

These donor-only sidecar package trees (Termux X11 app classes, any.mapper integration, alternate XServer bridge packages, compose/UI experiment lanes, and other adjunct packages) are not part of the current Ae.solator app graph. They require explicit integration design rather than blind donor import.

These final donor-only residuals are foreign or unwired adjunct files on the current Ae.solator source line: extra winlator native subtree files, donor-only cmod core adjuncts, asset metadata, and external manifest fragments. They do not represent missing live product logic on the active app graph.
The module-level gradle property surface is already owned by the live Ae.solator build contract; donor drift here does not supersede the current source-of-truth module configuration.

Final raw-audit closure for current Ae.solator donor frontier. These remaining changed paths are current local app/runtime divergences after high-signal logic lanes were adjudicated. The live cmod/Ae.solator source remains product truth for this snapshot.

Final raw-audit closure for current Ae.solator donor frontier. These remaining donor-only paths are non-adopted app/runtime/asset proposals or fork baggage outside the active app graph for this snapshot and are rejected rather than imported blindly.
